notes: «وعن قيس بن مسلم» is a second route for the same saying, joined by «و» not «ح»: written as its own group, both ending at Abu Sa'id, so the tail is null
the Companion Abu Sa'id answers and relays the Prophet's words; the man who speaks to Marwan is in the scene only
the archive flag (the same name twice) is Abu Sa'id, written twice on purpose
